table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end, 
			itemcounter=1,
			reprintdate=getdate(),
			users.username,  
			accounts.name, 
			headerno =max(saleledger.headerno),
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         date = Case :ai_printdate When 1 Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate When 2 Then dbo.saleledger.date When 3 Then dbo.saleledger.Billingdate  End, 
         dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
         dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
         dbo.saleledger.remarks,
   		dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
         dbo.saledetail.icode,   
         dbo.saledetail.gcode,
         max(saleledger.salecatcode),
			Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),     
         looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
			packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
			packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	 		saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	 		rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
         salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
         discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc), 
			customername='                                  '  ,
         itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
			unitsalestax  = max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
			gstperc       = max(saledetail.gstperc),
			invgstperc    = max(saleledger.invgstperc1),
			reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
			patient=(SELECT patient.name FROM patient WHERE patient.patientcode=dbo.saleledger.patientcode),
			doctor=(SELECT doctors.name FROM doctors WHERE doctors.doctcode=dbo.saleledger.doctcode),
			patientreg=(SELECT patient.regno FROM patient WHERE patient.patientcode=dbo.saleledger.patientcode)

    FROM dbo.saleledger,   
         dbo.saledetail,  
         item, 
		customer, 
		accounts,
		users
   WHERE ((Case :ai_printdate 
				When 1 Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate
				When 2 Then dbo.saleledger.date 
				When 3 Then dbo.saleledger.Billingdate  End) >=:ad_sdate)AND
			((Case :ai_printdate 
				When 1 Then dbo.saleledger.originaldate
				When 2 Then dbo.saleledger.date 
				When 3 Then dbo.saleledger.Billingdate  End) <=:ad_ldate)AND
			( dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:aa_custcode)) AND 
			( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
			( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
			( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
			( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
			( saledetail.icode = item.icode ) 

GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
         saleledger.originaldate,
			saleledger.date, 
			saleledger.billingdate,
			/*saleledger.headerno,*/
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.discperc, 
			saleledger.flatdisc, 
			saleledger.misccharges, 
			saleledger.salestax, 
			saleledger.remarks,
			saleledger.custrefno, 
			saleledger.patientcode,
			saleledger.doctcode,
			saledetail.icode, 
			saledetail.rowgroup,
			saledetail.gcode, 
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable, 
			accounts.name,
			dbo.users.username

ORDER BY saleledger.saleinvcode,
			MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) ,2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1 ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , f_NumberPreferences('roundsaleinvon'))  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2), f_NumberPreferences('roundsaleinvon'))

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01),2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)
